evaluation_target: Probability that the frozen candidate passes the pinned official checker

official_evaluator.tests: Unmodified per-task test field from the pinned dataset
official_evaluator.result_handling: Persist the complete evaluator result; do not override its verdict
official_evaluator.seed_policy: Preserve upstream behavior; no injected seed bank, changed shots, or majority voting
official_evaluator.resume_policy: Reuse the recorded evaluator result; never rerun a completed evaluation until it passes
official_evaluator.service_failure: No evaluator return value means missing result, not a fabricated official verdict

comparison: Use the official criterion; align dataset revision, task set, sampling budget, prompting conditions and metric before claiming direct cross-paper comparability
